mapper.select: SELECT id, username, title, content, name AS registrantName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks ( username, title, content, name, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{title}, #{content}, #{registrantName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, name = #{registrantName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = date_trunc('second', now()) WHERE id = #{id} AND username = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, title, content, name AS registrantName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
